# Spark

![Spark](https://scholzdev.github.io/tossup/img/coins/spark.png)

Energy or a small strike.

- **Rarity:** Uncommon
- **Heads chance:** 50%
- **Shop price:** 15 gold
- **Energy to flip:** 0

## Heads
Gain 2 energy

## Tails
Score 3 points

## Who can use it
- **Starts in the deck of:** [The Seer](characters-seer)
- **Usable in coin sets from the start:** [The Seer](characters-seer)
- **Found in the shop and unlocked by buying it once:** [The Blade](characters-blade), [The Trader](characters-trader)
